No.F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
18-4-1998.-----The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Authority for
Aiwan-e-Iqbal Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

2. Definitions.--In this
Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires,--
(a) "Aiwan-e-Iqbal"
means the Aiwan-e-Iqbal Complex, Lahore;
(b) "Authority" means
the Authority for Aiwan-e-Iqbal established under section 3;
(c) "Board" means the
Board of Governors constitution under section 5;
(d) "Chairman" means
Chairman of the Board;
(e) "Executive
Committee" means the Executive Committee of the Board;
(f) "Government" means
the Government of Pakistan;
(g) "member" means a
member of the Board; and
(h) "regulations" means
the regulations made under this Ordinance

Constitution of the Authority

3. Constitution of the
Authority.--(1) There shall be established an Authority to be known as the
"Authority for Aiwan-e-Iqbal".
(2) The Authority shall be a body
corporate having perpetual succession and common seal, with power, subject to
the provisions of this Ordinance, to acquire, hold and dispose of property,
both movable and immovable, and shall by its name sue or to be sued.

Management of the Authority

4. Management of the
Authority.---The general directions and administration of the Authority and
its affairs shall vest in the Board of Governors which may exercise all powers
and do all acts and things which may be exercised or done by the Authority.

Constitution of the Board

5. Constitution of the
Board.--(1) The Board shall consist of a Chairman and so many other number
of members as the Government may, from time to time, determine.
(2) The Chairman and the members
shall be appointed by the Government.
(3) The Chairman, or a member
other than an ex-officio members, shall hold office for a term of three years
and shall be eligible to be appointed for another term or terms or such shorter
period as the Government make deem fit.
(4) The Chairman may, by writing under his hands address
to the Government, resign his office.
(5) A member other than an
ex-officio member may, by writing under his hands addressed to the Chairman,
resign his office.
(6) A casual vacancy in the
office of the Chairman or a member other than an ex-officio member, may be
filled by appointing another person and such shall hold office for the
unexpired period of the terms of his predecessor.
(7) No act or proceedings of the
Board shall be invalid merely on the ground of the existence of any vacancy in,
or in defect in the constitution of the Board.

6. Meetings.--(1) The
Board shall meet at Aiwan-e-Iqbal Complex, Lahore, or such other place as it
may deem appropriate and follow such rules and procedure in regard to the
transaction of business as it may prescribed by regulations.
(2) The Chairman, and in his
absence, any other member elected by the members present shall preside over the
meeting of the Board.
(3) The decisions at the meeting
of the Board shall be taken by a majority of the members present and voting.
(4) The quorum for a meeting
shall be such as may be prescribed by regulations.

CHAPTER III
POWERS AND FUNCTIONS
OF THE AUTHORITY
7. Functions of the
Authority.--The following shall be the functions of the Authority,
namely:--
(a) to manage, control and
maintain Aiwan-e-Iqbal, and administer its affairs;
(b) to propagate the teachings of
Allama Muhammad Iqbal;
(c) to spread Allama Muhammad
Iqbal's message of constant struggle for the glory of Islam and Muslim ummah;
(d) to work for the revival of
the spirit of Ijtehad as advocated by Allama Muhammad Iqbal;
(e) to promote study, research
and scholarship of Allama Muhammad Iqbal's thoughts and teachings; and
(f) to perform such other
functions as are ancillary or incidental to any of the above functions.

8. Executive Committee.--(1)
The Board shall be assisted by an Executive Committee comprising of such
members not exceeding seven as may be appointed by the Government, from time to
time.
(2) The Executive Committee may
coopt any person as its member for any specific purpose.

9. Functions of the Executive

from time to time, give the Executive Committee shall exercise control over the
administration, management and maintenance of the Aiwan-e-Iqbal Complex and
perform all other functions of the Authority.

10. Delegation of powers.----The
Authority may, by general or special orders, and subject to such conditions and
limitations as it may specify in the order, delegate to the Chairman, a member,
or an officer of the Authority any of its powers, duties or functions under
this Ordinance.

servants, experts and consultants as it may consider necessary for the
efficient performance of the functions of the Authority on such terms and
conditions as it may deem fit.

12. Finance, accounts and
audit of Aiwan-e-Iqbal Fund.--(1) There shall be formed a fund to be known
as the "Aiwan-e-Iqbal Fund" which shall vest in the Board and shall
be utilized by the Board to meet the charges in connection with its functions
under this Ordinance. .
(2) To the credit of the Fund
shall be placed----
(a) the balance in the Iqbal
Memorial Fund established under the Finance Division's O.M.
No.F4(1)/PF.V/77-2931, dated the 21st November, 1977, the Aiwan-e-Iqbal
Maintenance Account and the Aiwan-e-Iqbal Library Account, Aiwan-e-Iqbal as on
the coming into force of this Ordinance.
(b) grants made by the Federal
and Provincial Governments and local authorities;
(c) donations including donations
from foreign Governments;
(d) loans including loans
obtained from any Government;
(e) sale proceeds of movable and
immovable property and receipts for services rendered;
(f) rental income of any part of
the premises of the Aiwan-e-lqbal and other properties vesting in the
Authority; and
(g) hire charges accruing from
the use of any part of the Aiwan-e-lqbal.

etc.-----The Authority shall maintain complete and accurate books of
accounts in respect of the Fund and other relevant records.

14. Audit.--(1) The
accounts of the Authority shall be annually audited by an auditor who is a
Chartered Accountant within the meaning of the Chartered Accountants Ordinance,
1961 (X of 1961), appointed by the Board.
(2) The accounts of the Authority
shall also be audited by the Auditor General of Pakistan and the Federal
Government shall cause the audited accounts of the Authority to be laid before
the National Assembly.
